title: Review: A Documentary That Changed How You Think
prompt:
You see the following notice on an English-language website:

'We are looking for reviews of a documentary that changed the way you think about a subject. Tell us what the documentary was about, what made it memorable, and whether you would recommend it to others.'

Write your review in 220-260 words.
notes: Look for: an engaging opening that doesn't just restate the task; a clear, concise summary of the documentary's subject (not an overlong plot retelling); specific detail on what made it memorable, with evaluative language and varied, precise adjectives beyond 'interesting'/'good'; a clear final recommendation addressed to the reader.
